name: i1
description: i1 is a 3-billion-parameter text-to-image diffusion model developed by ZLab at Princeton University. Introduced in 'i1: A Simple and Fully Open Recipe for Strong Text-to-Image Models', it provides a fully open foundation—including model weights, PyTorch and JAX training/inference code, and curated caption datasets—built upon a LightningDiT cross-attention backbone with T5-Gemma-2B and FLUX.2 VAE.
keyFeatures: Fully Open Ecosystem: Complete open-sourcing of model weights (1B & 3B), training/inference code (PyTorch/JAX), data processing pipelines, and datasets.
Diffusion Transformer Backbone: XL/2-sized LightningDiT cross-attention architecture featuring QK-normalization, long skip connections, T5-Gemma-2B text encoder adapter, and FLUX.2 VAE.
Systematic Empirical Recipe: Engineered through 300+ controlled experiments over 700,000+ TPU v6e hours analyzing dataset mixing, captioning strategies, and scaling.
Synthetic Caption Pipeline: Trained on i1-captions, a 160M+ sample dataset annotated with detailed synthetic captions from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B.
Dual Framework Support: Production-ready inference and training scripts available natively in both PyTorch and JAX.
curatorNotes: Verified academic research paper and open-source release from ZLab at Princeton University. Paper on arXiv (2606.11289), repository under MIT License on GitHub, and 3B/1B model weights on Hugging Face.
